title: Expectation of a biased bit
statement: Let $0\leq \delta\leq 1$ and let $g$ be a real-valued function on the two-point set $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Under the probability law assigning mass $1-\delta$ to $\mathrm{false}$ and mass $\delta$ to $\mathrm{true}$, the expectation of $g$ is $(1-\delta)g(\mathrm{false})+\delta g(\mathrm{true})$.
